# schema/cursor_token_implicit — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# Mirrors cursor_token.yml but omits the explicit
# {ref: cursor.token} value at query.cursor. The runner lowers
# `pagination.cursor_token.send_as: query.cursor` into an auto-injection
# at that slot on the producer step — implicit-form ergonomics, same
# wire shape as the explicit-form template.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    initial_interval:
      type: duration
      default: "720h"
    page_size:
      type: int
      default: 5
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - method: GET
    path: /api/v1/findings
    query:
      limit: {format: string, value: {ref: state.page_size}}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: response.body.findings

pagination:
  cursor_token:
    token_at: response.body.next_cursor
    send_as: query.cursor

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: created_at

error:
  mode: standard
